name: Kirina
source:
Side character of episode 2
Born in a cave to which her parents evacuated after an incident in 2024, Kirina has little to no connection with the modern civilization. After many years of survival, she, along with [url=/c92685]Harumi[/url] and [url=/c92665]Ritsu[/url], is the remaining survivors of Sanze village.
[spoiler]As time passes by, Kirina becomes the last person alive. Living alone in the cave, her life only faces a drastic change after she saving [url=/c92658]Chisa[/url] from being drowned in the river nearby. The event marks the start of their 4-year coexistence.[/spoiler]
An innocent and immature girl. Her name "Kirina" (希里奈), following her mother's interpretation, means "the big hope of the village" (里の大きな希望).
